title: Service Video Playout: purpose and scope
summary: ooRexx controls audiovisual scene selection; Foreign Runtime v0.22.6 binds a resident C11 playout worker; Linux V4L2 and PipeWire expose the output as an ordinary browser camera and microphone. Browser and WhatsApp are consumers, not project-owned transports.
invariants: Preserve a continuous physical or virtual output endpoint while the presentation changes.
Application intentions and business truth never move into the native video worker.
A development candidate and an acceptance-gated GitHub submission are not production-certified releases.
procedure: Read svplay.architecture, svplay.media, svplay.hold and svplay.qualification before editing.
Locate the exact dev3 source delivery and verify its SHA-256.
Use the GitHub submission commit as a source cross-reference, not as evidence of Autobuild acceptance.
